items.name: MothFairy
items.note: Hada polilla: alas grandes con ojos, antenas con cristal
items.prompt:
Generate ONE 2D game enemy sprite for a dark fantasy mobile roguelite: a tiny moth fairy with big soft moth wings and a fuzzy body. Side view facing right, full body, centered, SQUARE 1:1 image. One single character only: NOT a sprite sheet, no animation frames, no variations.

ART STYLE: Dark fantasy mobile game. Colour world of a magical forest and crystal theme (colours only, not materials). Saturated emerald and moss green, earthy browns, aged stone, bark and soft golden highlights. Emerald/turquoise accents only on crystals and eyes. Painted digital illustration, stylized semi-realistic, slight texture, no grain/haze outside the character.

CHARACTER: Cream and moss-green fuzzy body, large round dusk-moth wings with eye-spot patterns in forest greens and teal, feathery antennae, calm sleepy face. A winged creature that flies: it has wings and is airborne. NO standing on the ground; legs, if its kind has them, hang or tuck under the body. No arms unless the kind naturally has them. Use the zone's colour palette only: its materials follow the creature's own nature (a robot stays metal, an animal stays an animal) and it is NOT covered in snow, ice, leaves or rock unless the design says so. It carries 1-3 glowing emerald-turquoise forest crystals: one crystal on the forehead like a lantern and one at the tip of each antenna.

ATTACK: It attacks with MAGIC, but the picture shows NO weapon, NO staff, nothing held and NO spell effect: just the plain creature in its calm idle form. The part it casts with (hand, mouth, horn…) is drawn normally, closed or relaxed; a different version of that part will be drawn later to cast. Its casting part is the hands: draw it plainly, in its idle form.

POSE (the character will be cut into separate pieces afterwards, so EVERY piece must be fully visible): Calm airborne pose, wings fully spread out to the sides and open, never folded or hidden behind the body, each wing one clear shape. Body in the middle, head forward (to the RIGHT of the image). Every piece of the body must be fully visible: no piece hides more than about 10% of another, and nothing covers a limb, the head or a joint. Each piece is one closed shape with its own full outline and a clearly visible contour where it touches the next one (the character is cut into separate pieces afterwards). Name sides by the image (the one on the LEFT / RIGHT of the image).

PIECES — exactly these 5, no more (no extra limbs, hands, weapons or loose parts; each piece joins its neighbour at a visible joint and has a clearly visible contour where they touch):
1. Head
2. Body (torso)
3. Wing (near side)
4. Wing (far side)
5. Legs or tail (only if its kind has them)

EDGE RULES (critical):
- Clean, crisp, hard silhouette with a 2px near-black outline all around, and a slightly darker contour line where pieces meet.
- NO glow, aura, halo, bloom, particles, snow, frost mist, dust, smoke, embers, blur or soft edges outside the outline. Crystal glow stays inside the silhouette.
- ABSOLUTELY NO effects of any kind: no energy beams, no muzzle flashes, no impact bursts, no motion lines. NO cast shadows, NO ground. A flame or glow that belongs to the body is one flat color inside its own outline.
- Background: perfectly flat, uniform pure white, zero gradient or noise, even if an attached reference image has sky or scenery. The character contains no pure white fill touching the background (use pale colors).
